group_size.en: Groups of three; rotate BHW, resident and observer.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid.

purpose.fil: Suriin ang posibleng sanhi gamit ang ebidensiya.

materials.en: Full Rosario case or a prepared fictional case with evidence
materials.fil: Buong kaso ni Rosario o inihandang kathang kasong may ebidensiya

steps.en: Choose: missed prenatal visit, stroke, child diarrhoea death, maternal death or Rosario. Use a prepared fictional/de-identified case, never an identifiable death review.
steps.fil: Pumili: hindi pagdalo sa prenatal, stroke, pagkamatay ng batang nagtatae, maternal death o Rosario. Gumamit ng inihandang kathang/walang pagkakakilanlang kaso.

steps.en: Define the problem. Draw causes below and effects above; ask why and mark each answer as supported or needing verification.
steps.fil: Tukuyin ang problema. Iguhit ang sanhi sa ibaba at epekto sa itaas; itanong kung bakit at markahan kung may batayan o dapat tiyakin.

steps.en: Compare resident, BHW and health-team perspectives. Present the map and revise an unsupported assumption.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang pananaw ng residente, BHW at health team. Ipakita ang mapa at iwasto ang palagay na walang batayan.

debrief.en: Which explanation needs evidence? Is there another branch?
debrief.fil: Aling paliwanag ang kailangan ng ebidensiya? May ibang sangay ba?

observe.en: Defines the problem factually and connects why questions to evidence.
observe.fil: Datos ang batayan ng problema at may ebidensiya ang magkakaugnay na bakit.

output.fil: Mapa ng sanhi na may mga dapat pang tiyakin.

alternative.en: Use the missed-visit scenario in the lesson if no complete case is available.
alternative.fil: Gamitin ang hindi pagdalo sa aralin kung walang buong kaso.

worksheet.en: Problem / possible cause / evidence / missing information / effect
worksheet.fil: Problema / posibleng sanhi / ebidensiya / kulang na impormasyon / epekto

group_size.en: Groups of three; rotate BHW, resident and observer.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid.

purpose.en: Turn analysis into a feasible community proposal.
purpose.fil: Gawing kayang mungkahing pangkomunidad ang pagsusuri.

steps.en: Use the cause map. Score problems 1–5 for magnitude, seriousness, feasibility and urgency; explain the evidence for each score.
steps.fil: Gamitin ang mapa. Markahan ng 1–5 ang laki, kabigatan, feasibility at urgency; ipaliwanag ang batayan.

steps.en: Compare two actions; name affected residents, health-team and local-leader partners.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang dalawang aksiyon; tukuyin ang residente, health team at lokal na lider na katuwang.

steps.en: Role-play a planning discussion; agree owner, resources, date and outcome measure. Present a one-minute recommendation.
steps.fil: Isadula ang pagpaplano; pagkasunduan ang responsable, kagamitan, petsa at sukatan. Maglahad ng isang minutong mungkahi.

debrief.en: What needs a partner's agreement? How will we know the barrier improved?
debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangang pagkasunduan sa katuwang? Paano malalaman kung nabawasan ang hadlang?

observe.en: Uses four criteria correctly and links actions to causes, owners and review dates.
observe.fil: Tama ang apat na pamantayan at kaugnay ng sanhi, responsable at review date ang aksiyon.

output.en: Score sheet and community action proposal.
output.fil: Score sheet at mungkahing aksiyong pangkomunidad.

alternative.en: Analyse two problems rather than a full list.
alternative.fil: Dalawang problema lamang kung maikli ang oras.

worksheet.en: Problem / four scores / evidence / action / partner / owner / resources / date / outcome
worksheet.fil: Problema / apat na marka / ebidensiya / aksiyon / katuwang / responsable / kagamitan / petsa / resulta
